card.name: Capital O starting opioid or ophthalmic
card.fires_on: The single capital letter O that begins a word split into pieces, mostly Opioid (also Ophthalmic, Ocular, Oritavancin), right after a heading number or a word like of, Other or for. It sits in section headings of drug labels.

modes.label: Opioid in headings
modes.description: The letter O opening the word Opioid in treatment or dosing headings.
modes.example: Initial Dosing for Detoxification and Maintenance Treatment of<< O>>pioid Addiction For detoxification and maintenance

modes.label: Other O-words at section starts
modes.description: The letter O opening Ophthalmic, Ocular or Oritavancin at the start of a heading or sentence.

modes.label: Rare whole word
modes.description: Occasionally a whole word such as maintain in a section heading.
modes.example: To<< maintain>> platelet inhibition after discontinuation of K

card.writes: It promotes forms of the word partial and suppresses stick and power, so it has no obvious link to the text pattern.
card.plain: It lights up on the first letter O when a word like Opioid is broken into pieces in a label heading.
